representation.name: Codex PhyKIT RCV table
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - <<'PY'
import os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

inputs = [
    ("animal", "$(inputs.animal_zip.path)"),
    ("fungal", "$(inputs.fungal_zip.path)"),
]
float_re = re.compile(r'[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?')

def safe_member_name(name):
    p = Path(name)
    if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts:
        raise ValueError(f"unsafe zip member: {name}")
    return p.name

def parse_rcv(stdout):
    nums = float_re.findall(stdout)
    if not nums:
        raise ValueError(f"no numeric RCV found in PhyKIT output: {stdout!r}")
    return float(nums[-1])

with open('rcv_scores.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('group\trcv\tortholog\n')
    total = {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        work = Path(td)
        for group, archive_path in inputs:
            extracted = work / group
            extracted.mkdir()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
                members = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft') and not n.endswith('/'))
                if not members:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"no .faa.mafft alignments found for {group}")
                total[group] = len(members)
                for idx, name in enumerate(members, 1):
                    ortholog = safe_member_name(name).replace('.faa.mafft', '')
                    aln = extracted / f"{idx:06d}_{safe_member_name(name)}"
                    with zf.open(name) as src, open(aln, 'wb') as dst:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
                    proc = subprocess.run(
                        ['phykit', 'relative_composition_variability', str(aln)],
                        text=True, capture_output=True, check=False,
                    )
                    if proc.returncode != 0:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"PhyKIT failed for {group} {name}: {proc.stderr}\n{proc.stdout}")
                    rcv = parse_rcv(proc.stdout)
                    out.write(f"{group}\t{rcv:.17g}\t{ortholog}\n")
    with open('summary.txt', 'w') as s:
        for group in sorted(total):
            s.write(f"{group}\t{total[group]}\n")
PY

import os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

inputs = [
    ("animal", "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549320/inputs/dataset_8b4b72ea-0eeb-4bac-8c9d-fe8981e98bc5.dat"),
    ("fungal", "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549320/inputs/dataset_178f523f-6705-4cca-b5c3-a22f134c02e6.dat"),
]
float_re = re.compile(r'[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?')

def safe_member_name(name):
    p = Path(name)
    if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts:
        raise ValueError(f"unsafe zip member: {name}")
    return p.name

def parse_rcv(stdout):
    nums = float_re.findall(stdout)
    if not nums:
        raise ValueError(f"no numeric RCV found in PhyKIT output: {stdout!r}")
    return float(nums[-1])

with open('rcv_scores.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('group\trcv\tortholog\n')
    total = {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        work = Path(td)
        for group, archive_path in inputs:
            extracted = work / group
            extracted.mkdir()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
                members = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft') and not n.endswith('/'))
                if not members:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"no .faa.mafft alignments found for {group}")
                total[group] = len(members)
                for idx, name in enumerate(members, 1):
                    ortholog = safe_member_name(name).replace('.faa.mafft', '')
                    aln = extracted / f"{idx:06d}_{safe_member_name(name)}"
                    with zf.open(name) as src, open(aln, 'wb') as dst:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
                    proc = subprocess.run(
                        ['phykit', 'relative_composition_variability', str(aln)],
                        text=True, capture_output=True, check=False,
                    )
                    if proc.returncode != 0:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"PhyKIT failed for {group} {name}: {proc.stderr}\n{proc.stdout}")
                    rcv = parse_rcv(proc.stdout)
                    out.write(f"{group}\t{rcv:.17g}\t{ortholog}\n")
    with open('summary.txt', 'w') as s:
        for group in sorted(total):
            s.write(f"{group}\t{total[group]}\n")
PY

inputs:

import base64, textwrap
script = r'''
import os, re, subprocess, sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

animals_zip = sys.argv[1]
fungi_zip = sys.argv[2]
out_path = Path(sys.argv[3])
work = Path('rcv_work')
work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
float_re = re.compile(r'[-+]?(?:\\d*\\.\\d+|\\d+\\.?)(?:[eE][-+]?\\d+)?')

def rcv_for_file(path):
    commands = [
        ['phykit', 'rcv', str(path)],
        ['phykit', 'relative_composition_variability', str(path)],
    ]
    last_error = None
    for cmd in commands:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        if proc.returncode == 0:
            text = (proc.stdout + '\\n' + proc.stderr).strip()
            nums = float_re.findall(text)
            if not nums:
                raise RuntimeError('No numeric RCV value found in output for %s: %s' % (path, text))
            return nums[-1]
        last_error = proc.stderr.strip() or proc.stdout.strip()
    raise RuntimeError('PhyKIT rcv failed for %s: %s' % (path, last_error))

def iter_scores(label, archive_path):
    rows = []
    target_dir = work / label
    target_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
        names = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft') and not n.endswith('/'))
        for i, name in enumerate(names, 1):
            data = zf.read(name)
            ortholog = Path(name).name[:-len('.faa.mafft')]
            aln_path = target_dir / ('%05d_%s.faa.mafft' % (i, ortholog))
            aln_path.write_bytes(data)
            rows.append((label, ortholog, rcv_for_file(aln_path)))
    return rows

rows = []
rows.extend(iter_scores('animal', animals_zip))
rows.extend(iter_scores('fungal', fungi_zip))
if not rows:
    raise RuntimeError('No .faa.mafft alignments found')
with out_path.open('w') as out:
    out.write('group\\tortholog\\trcv\\n')
    for group, ortholog, value in rows:
        out.write('%s\\t%s\\t%s\\n' % (group, ortholog, value))
'''.strip() + '\\n'
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())

from pathlib import Path
from phykit.services.alignment.base import Alignment
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

def scores(dirpath, ids=None, rounded=True):
    vals=[]
    rows=[]
    paths=sorted(Path(dirpath).glob('*.faa.mafft'))
    for p in paths:
        oid=p.name.removesuffix('.faa.mafft')
        if ids is not None and oid not in ids:
            continue
        v=Alignment(alignment_file_path=str(p)).calculate_rcv()
        if rounded:
            v=round(v,4)
        vals.append(v)
        rows.append((oid,v))
    return vals, rows

animal_ids={p.name.removesuffix('.faa.mafft') for p in Path('work/scogs_animals').glob('*.faa.mafft')}
fungi_ids={p.name.removesuffix('.faa.mafft') for p in Path('work/scogs_fungi').glob('*.faa.mafft')}
shared=animal_ids & fungi_ids
for rounded in [True, False]:
    for scope, ids in [('all', None), ('shared', shared)]:
        a,_=scores('work/scogs_animals', ids, rounded)
        f,_=scores('work/scogs_fungi', ids, rounded)
        print('rounded', rounded, 'scope', scope, 'n', len(a), len(f))
        print('means', sum(a)/len(a), sum(f)/len(f), 'medians', sorted(a)[len(a)//2], sorted(f)[len(f)//2])
        for method in ['auto','asymptotic','exact']:
            try:
                res=mannwhitneyu(a, f, alternative='two-sided', method=method, use_continuity=True)
                print(method, 'U', res.statistic, 'p', format(res.pvalue, '.17g'))
            except Exception as e:
                print(method, 'ERR', type(e).__name__, e)
        print('greater p', format(mannwhitneyu(a,f,alternative='greater',method='asymptotic',use_continuity=True).pvalue,'.17g'))
        print('less p', format(mannwhitneyu(a,f,alternative='less',method='asymptotic',use_continuity=True).pvalue,'.17g'))
        print()
PY"

from pathlib import Path
from phykit.services.alignment.base import Alignment
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import subprocess

def phykit_score(p):
    return round(Alignment(alignment_file_path=str(p)).calculate_rcv(), 4)

animals=sorted(Path('work/scogs_animals').glob('*.faa.mafft'))
fungi=sorted(Path('work/scogs_fungi').glob('*.faa.mafft'))
# Verify a few imported PhyKIT values match the CLI-reported values.
for p in animals[:3] + fungi[:3]:
    cli=float(subprocess.check_output(['.venv/bin/phykit','rcv',str(p)], text=True).strip())
    lib=phykit_score(p)
    if cli "'!= lib:
        raise SystemExit(f'"'mismatch {p}: cli={cli} lib={lib}')

a=[phykit_score(p) for p in animals]
f=[phykit_score(p) for p in fungi]
res=mannwhitneyu(a, f, alternative='two-sided', method='asymptotic', use_continuity=True)
print(len(a), len(f), res.statistic, format(res.pvalue, '.17g'))
Path('codex_output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('codex_output/answer.txt').write_text(format(res.pvalue, '.17g') + '\\n')
print(Path('codex_output/answer.txt').read_text(), end='')
PY"

from pathlib import Path

from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from phykit.services.alignment.rcv import Alignment

scores={}
for group in ['animals','fungi']:
    vals=[]
    bad=[]
    for p in sorted(Path('work_rcv', group).glob('*.mafft')):
        try:

  history reference or built-in genome rather than a default branch.

# Phylogenetics Tree Metrics

Match the requested metric to its biological input object and observation unit.

- Branch-length sums, patristic distances, and long-branch metrics require
  phylogenetic trees with the relevant branch lengths and rooting assumptions.
- Informative-site, composition-variability, alignment-length, and gap metrics
  require multiple sequence alignments. A FASTA suffix alone does not prove the
  sequences are aligned.
- Sequence distance, patristic distance, total tree length, and evolutionary
  rate are different quantities. Use the requested definition and denominator.

Match the requested metric to its biological input object and observation unit.

  phylogenetic trees with the relevant branch lengths and rooting assumptions.

  require multiple sequence alignments. A FASTA suffix alone does not prove the
  sequences are aligned.

from pathlib import Path
from phykit.services.alignment.rcv import RelativeCompositionVariability
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

class Args:
    json=False

def score(p):
    Args.alignment=str(p)
    return RelativeCompositionVariability(Args()).calculate_rcv()

A=[score(p) for p in sorted(Path('work/animals').glob('*.faa.mafft'))]
F=[score(p) for p in sorted(Path('work/fungi').glob('*.faa.mafft'))]
for label, aa, ff in [('full',A,F),('round4',[round(x,4) for x in A],[round(x,4) for x in F]),('round3',[round(x,3) for x in A],[round(x,3) for x in F])]:
    for alternative in ['two-sided','less','greater']:
        r=mannwhitneyu(aa,ff,alternative=alternative)
        print(label, alternative, 'U',repr(float(r.statistic)), 'p',repr(float(r.pvalue)))
    print('ranges',min(aa),max(aa),min(ff),max(ff),'med',sorted(aa)[len(aa)//2],sorted(ff)[len(ff)//2])
print('n',len(A),len(F),'first',A[:5],F[:5])
print('ties full',len(A)+len(F)-len(set(A+F)),'rounded',len(A)+len(F)-len(set(round(x,4) for x in A+F)))
PY"

from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from phykit.services.alignment.base import Alignment
from Bio import AlignIO

root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['WORK_TMP'])
def scores(domain):
    out={}
    for p in sorted((root/domain).glob('*.faa.mafft')):
        out[p.name[:-len('.faa.mafft')]] = Alignment(alignment_file_path=str(p)).calculate_rcv()
    return out
A=scores('animals'); F=scores('fungi')
common=sorted(set(A)&set(F))

def tests(x,y):
    vals=[]
    for label,xx,yy in [('raw',x,y),('rounded4',[round(v,4) for v in x],[round(v,4) for v in y])]:
        for method in ['auto','asymptotic','exact']:
            try:
                res=mannwhitneyu(xx,yy,alternative='two-sided',method=method)
                vals.append((label,method,float(res.statistic),float(res.pvalue)))
            except Exception as e: vals.append((label,method,'ERR',repr(e)))
    return vals
print('counts',len(A),len(F),len(common))
for label,x,y in [
 ('all',list(A.values()),list(F.values())),
 ('common',[A[k] for k in common],[F[k] for k in common]),
]:
 print(label, 'summary', statistics.median(x),statistics.median(y),statistics.mean(x),statistics.mean(y))
 for row in tests(x,y): print(label,*row)
counts={}
for p in sorted((root/'animals').glob('*.faa.mafft')):

print('four_tests',tests([A[k] for k in four],[F[k] for k in four]))

description: Use only for Galaxy submissions with nested, repeated, conditional, paired, collection, or reference-selector inputs, or when raw API payload binding is uncertain. Skip simple submissions handled by a validating client.
---

# Galaxy Tool Submission

Use this skill after the scientific tool and parameters have been selected. Build
complex inputs from the selected wrapper's live schema and verify the created job
resolved the intended objects.

## Dataset Inputs

- Wait for uploaded data to reach `ok` with the expected datatype before using
  the final history dataset ID.
- Verify paired mates use distinct dataset IDs and preserve forward/reverse
  order.
- For reference-source conditionals, confirm the job resolved the intended
  history reference or built-in genome rather than a default branch.

## Nested And Repeated Payloads

- Use input format `21.01` for natural nested JSON, repeat lists, and conditional
  objects. Use legacy format onl

# Galaxy Tool Submission

Use this skill after the scientific tool and parameters have been selected. Build
complex inputs from the selected wrapper's live schema and verify the created job
resolved the intended objects.

## Dataset Inputs

- Wait for uploaded data to reach `ok` with the expected datatype before using
  the final history dataset ID.
- Verify paired mates use distinct dataset IDs and preserve forward/reverse
  order.
- For reference-source conditionals, confirm the job resolved the intended
  history reference or built-in genome rather than a default branch.

## Nested And Repeated Payloads

- Use input format `21.01` for natural nested JSON, repeat lists, and conditional
  objects. Use legacy format onl

from pathlib import Path
from Bio import AlignIO
from collections import Counter
from scipy import stats
import json, statistics
# old phykit formula

def old_rcv(p):
    aln=AlignIO.read(str(p),'fasta')
    aln_len=aln.get_alignment_length(); n=len(aln)
    concat=''.join(str(r.seq) for r in aln)
    total=Counter(concat)
    avg={c: total[c]/n for c in total}
    s=0
    for r in aln:
        rc=Counter(r.seq)
        s += sum(abs(rc.get(c,0)-avg[c]) for c in total)/(n*aln_len)
    return s

for grp in ['ani','fun']:
    vals={p.name.split('.')[0]: round(old_rcv(p),4) for p in Path('/workspace/tmp/extract_'+grp).glob('*.faa.mafft')}
    Path('/workspace/tmp/old_rcv_'+grp+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(vals,indent=2))
    a=list(vals.values())
    print(grp,len(a),'zeros',sum(v==0 for v in a),'median',statistics.median(a),'mean',statistics.mean(a),'minmax',min(a),max(a))
    globals()[grp]=a
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(ani,fun,alternative='two-sided')
print('old rounded p',repr(p),'u',u)
# raw
rawani=[]; rawfun=[]
for p in Path('/workspace/tmp/extract_ani').glob('*.faa.mafft'): rawani.append(old_rcv(p))
for p in Path('/workspace/tmp/extract_fun').glob('*.faa.mafft'): rawfun.append(old_rcv(p))
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(rawani,rawfun,alternative='two-sided')
print('old raw p',repr(p),'u',u)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Paired group comparison for BUSCO single-copy ortholog phylogenetics.

This script extracts BOTH `scogs_animals.zip` and `scogs_fungi.zip`,
computes the requested per-ortholog metric on every ortholog, and emits
both per-group summaries AND the cross-group Mann-Whitney U + p-value
in a single invocation. It exists to address timeouts the agent hits
when re-running per-group batches separately.

  patristic_distances, evolutionary_rate), it spawns one phykit process
  per file but extracts only ONCE per group. The agent had been re-running
  full extraction per question.
- It auto-falls-back across file naming v

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from scipy import stats
from statistics import median, mean

def old_rcv(path):
    # replicate phykit <=2.0: concat all record.seq including gaps; denom num_records*aln_len
    from Bio import AlignIO
    aln=AlignIO.read(str(path),'fasta')
    aln_len=aln.get_alignment_length(); num=len(aln)
    concat=''.join(str(r.seq) for r in aln)
    total=Counter(concat)
    avg={c:total[c]/num for c in total}
    vals=[]
    for r in aln:
        rc=Counter(str(r.seq))
        temp=sum(abs(rc[c]-avg[c]) for c in total)
        vals.append(temp/(num*aln_len))
    return sum(vals)

def vals(d):
    vv={}
    for p in sorted(Path(d).glob('*.faa.mafft')):

Perform the Mann-Whitney U rank test on two independent samples.

The Mann-Whitney U test is a nonparametric test of the null hypothesis
that the distribution underlying sample `x` is the same as the
distribution underlying sample `y`. It is often used as a test of
difference in location between distributions.

Parameters
----------
x, y : array-like
    N-d arrays of samples. The arrays must be broadcastable except along
    the dimension given by `axis`.
use_continuity : bool, optional
    Whether a continuity correction (1/2) should be applied.
    Default is True when `method` is ``'asymptotic'``; has no effect
    otherwise.
alternative : {'two-sided', 'less', 'greater'}, optional
    Defines the alternative hypothesis. Default is 'two-sided'.
    Let *SX(u)* and *SY(u)* be the survival functions of the
    distributions underlying `x` and `y`, respectively

Copy the Galaxy history with ID bbd44e69cb8906b5476fb93483ddf2e0 using the Galaxy API. Use the following BioBlend approach:

import os
import json
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

with open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']) as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

gi = GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

# Copy the history

print('Copy complete')
"

Publication link: https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article-abstract/37/16/2325/6131675

Calculate RCV (relative composition variability) for an alignment.

Lower RCV values are thought to be desirable because they represent
a lower composition bias in an alignment. Statistically, RCV describes
the average variability in sequence composition among taxa. 

RCV is calculated following Phillips and Penny, Molecular Phylogenetics
and Evolution (2003), doi: 10.1016/S1055-7903(03)00057-5.

source /workspace/venv/bin/activate && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess
import sys

# Get the shared genes list
with open('animal_genes.txt') as f:
    animal_genes = set(line.strip() for line in f)
with open('fungi_genes.txt') as f:
    fungi_genes = set(line.strip() for line in f)

shared = sorted(animal_genes & fungi_genes)
print(f"Number of shared orthologs: {len(shared)}")

# Run phykit rcv on all alignments
animal_rcv = []
fungi_rcv = []

for gene in shared:
    animal_file = f"work_animals/{gene}.mafft"
    fungi_file = f"work_fungi/{gene}.mafft"
    
    # Run phykit rcv on animal alignment
    result = subprocess.run(['phykit', 'rcv', animal_file], capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        animal_rcv.append(float(result.stdout.strip()))
    except:
        print(f"Failed to parse animal RCV for {gene}: {result.stdout}, {result.stderr}")
    
    # Run phykit rcv on fungal alignment
    result = subprocess.run(['phykit', 'rcv', fungi_file], capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        fungi_rcv.append(float(result.stdout.strip()))
    except:
        print(f"Failed to parse fungi RCV for {gene}: {result.stdout}, {result.stderr}")

print(f"\nAnimal RCV values: {len(animal_rcv)}")
print(f"Fungi RCV values: {len(fungi_rcv)}")

# Mann-Whitney U test
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
stat, pvalue = mannwhitneyu(animal_rcv, fungi_rcv, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\nMann-Whitney U statistic: {stat}")
print(f"p-value: {pvalue}")

# Summary stats
import numpy as np
print(f"\nAnimal RCV: mean={np.mean(animal_rcv):.4f}, median={np.median(animal_rcv):.4f}")
print(f"Fungi RCV: mean={np.mean(fungi_rcv):.4f}, median={np.median(fungi_rcv):.4f}")
PYEOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Compute RCV scores for animal and fungal orthologs using PhyKIT,
then compare distributions using Mann-Whitney U test.
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

PHYKIT = "/workspace/venv/bin/phykit"
ANIMALS_DIR = "/workspace/work"
FUNGI_DIR = "/workspace/work/fungi_scogs"

def get_ortholog_id(filename):
    """Extract ortholog ID from filename like '1260807at2759.faa.mafft'"""
    return filename.replace(".faa.mafft", "")

def run_rcv(alignment_path):
    """Run phykit rcv and return the score as a float."""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [PHYKIT, "rcv", alignment_path],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=60
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            print(f"Error running phykit rcv on {alignment_path}: {result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
            return None
        return float(result.stdout.strip())
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Exception running phykit rcv on {alignment_path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None

def main():
    # Get all animal mafft files
    animal_files = {}
    for f in os.listdir(ANIMALS_DIR):
        if f.endswith(".mafft"):
            ortho_id = get_ortholog_id(f)
            animal_files[ortho_id] = os.path.join(ANIMALS_DIR, f)

    # Get all fungal mafft files
    fungal_files = {}
    for f in os.listdir(FUNGI_DIR):
        if f.endswith(".mafft"):
            ortho_id = get_ortholog_id(f)
            fungal_files[ortho_id] = os.path.join(FUNGI_DIR, f)

    # Find common orthologs
    common_orthologs = sorted(set(animal_files.keys()) & set(fungal_files.keys()))
    print(f"Animal orthologs: {len(animal_files)}")
    print(f"Fungal orthologs: {len(fungal_files)}")
    print(f"Common orthologs: {len(common_orthologs)}")

    # Compute RCV for each common ortholog
    animal_rcv = []
    fungal_rcv = []

    for i, ortho_id in enumerate(common_orthologs):
        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"Processing {i+1}/{len(common_orthologs)}...")

        animal_score = run_rcv(animal_files[ortho_id])
        fungal_score = run_rcv(fungal_files[ortho_id])

        if animal_score is not None and fungal_score is not None:
            animal_rcv.append(animal_score)
            fungal_rcv.append(fungal_score)

    print(f"\nSuccessfully computed RCV for {len(animal_rcv)} ortholog pairs")

    # Summary stats
    import numpy as np
    print(f"\nAnimal RCV: mean={np.mean(animal_rcv):.4f}, median={np.median(animal_rcv):.4f}, std={np.std(animal_rcv):.4f}")
    print(f"Fungal RCV: mean={np.mean(fungal_rcv):.4f}, median={np.median(fungal_rcv):.4f}, std={np.std(fungal_rcv):.4f}")

    # Mann-Whitney U test
    stat, p_value = mannwhitneyu(animal_rcv, fungal_rcv, alternative='two-sided')

    print(f"\nMann-Whitney U statistic: {stat}")
    print(f"p-value: {p_value}")

    # Write answer
    os.makedirs("/workspace/codex_output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(f"{p_value}\n")

    print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {p_value}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import subprocess
import os
import sys
from scipy import stats

phykit = "/workspace/venv/bin/phykit"

def get_rcv_scores(msa_dir):
    scores = []
    errors = []
    for fname in sorted(os.listdir(msa_dir)):
        if not fname.endswith('.mafft'):
            continue
        fpath = os.path.join(msa_dir, fname)
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [phykit, 'rcv', fpath],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
            )
            if result.returncode != 0:
                errors.append((fname, result.stderr.strip()))
                continue
            rcv_val = float(result.stdout.strip())
            scores.append((fname.replace('.faa.mafft', ''), rcv_val))
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append((fname, str(e)))
    return scores, errors

print("Computing animal RCV scores...")
animal_scores, animal_errs = get_rcv_scores("/workspace/tmp_animals")
print(f"  Got {len(animal_scores)} scores, {len(animal_errs)} errors")

print("Computing fungal RCV scores...")
fungal_scores, fungal_errs = get_rcv_scores("/workspace/tmp_fungi")
print(f"  Got {len(fungal_scores)} scores, {len(fungal_errs)} errors")

if animal_errs:
    print(f"Animal errors (first 5): {animal_errs[:5]}")
if fungal_errs:
    print(f"Fungal errors (first 5): {fungal_errs[:5]}")

# Print summary stats
animal_vals = [s[1] for s in animal_scores]
fungal_vals = [s[1] for s in fungal_scores]

print(f"\nAnimal RCV: n={len(animal_vals)}, mean={sum(animal_vals)/len(animal_vals):.4f}, min={min(animal_vals):.4f}, max={max(animal_vals):.4f}")
print(f"Fungal RCV: n={len(fungal_vals)}, mean={sum(fungal_vals)/len(fungal_vals):.4f}, min={min(fungal_vals):.4f}, max={max(fungal_vals):.4f}")

# Mann-Whitney U test
stat, p_value = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\nMann-Whitney U test: statistic={stat}, p-value={p_value}")

# Also print with more precision
print(f"p-value (full precision): {p_value:.15e}")
PYEOF

from scipy import stats

# Reconstruct from the scores
import subprocess, os

phykit = "/workspace/venv/bin/phykit"

animal_vals = []
for fname in sorted(os.listdir("/workspace/tmp_animals")):
    if fname.endswith('.mafft'):
        r = subprocess.run([phykit, 'rcv', f"/workspace/tmp_animals/{fname}"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        animal_vals.append(float(r.stdout.strip()))

fungal_vals = []
for fname in sorted(os.listdir("/workspace/tmp_fungi")):
    if fname.endswith('.mafft'):
        r = subprocess.run([phykit, 'rcv', f"/workspace/tmp_fungi/{fname}"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        fungal_vals.append(float(r.stdout.strip()))

print(f"Animals: n={len(animal_vals)}, mean={sum(animal_vals)/len(animal_vals):.6f}")
print(f"Fungi:   n={len(fungal_vals)}, mean={sum(fungal_vals)/len(fungal_vals):.6f}")

# Test with different settings
# Default: use_continuity=True, method='auto' (asymptotic), alternative='two-sided'
s1, p1 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\nDefault (continuity=True, two-sided):  U={s1}, p={p1:.15e}")

s2, p2 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='two-sided', use_continuity=False)
print(f"No continuity correction, two-sided: U={s2}, p={p2:.15e}")

s3, p3 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='greater')
print(f"Continuity=True, greater:            U={s3}, p={p3:.15e}")

s4, p4 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='less')
print(f"Continuity=True, less:               U={s4}, p={p4:.15e}")
